description: List the tools for one job in the ZeroCrew directory, like role "support" and job "ai-receptionists", A to Z by default. ZeroCrew doesn't rank them. Set sort to "must_use" or "using_now" to order them by how many ZeroCrew Developers rate a tool a must use or use it now; the answer says which order it used. Returns up to 50 tools. list_roles shows every role and job.

job.description: The job's slug in that role, like "ai-receptionists".

name: list_job
title: List the tools for a job
